summary: abandoned_but_not_forgotten is a storytelling website about the Moon and Mars. Over fifty years ago, the Apollo missions took humans to the Moon, and when the astronauts returned home, they left pieces of themselves behind: lunar landers, rovers, flags, and scientific instruments, still resting in the silence of the lunar dust. Mars, too, holds machines that once worked tirelessly and now stand alone. Our website brings these stories to life through narrative, visuals, and NASA open data, showing where each mission landed, what it achieved, and why it fell silent. Abandoned does not mean forgotten. These artifacts  represent human courage and curiosity, and they inspire the next
details:
project– Abandoned but Not Forgotten is an educational website exploring equipment left on the Moon and Mars after space missions.

It provides mission history, equipment details, launch years, countries, discoveries, and last-known conditions.

Our goal is to preserve space exploration history and make scientific information easy to understand through digital storytelling.

The website is developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with information from official NASA resources.

Its unique approach combines historical research and organized mission data to create an informative learning experience for students, educators, and space enthusiasts.
